title: Museum of Utah

services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: Explore the past, understand the present, and look ahead to our shared future at the new Museum of Utah, now open on the Capitol Complex. As the first dedicated state history museum in Utah, the Museum of Utah celebrates our unique history, culture and art through world-class exhibits, programming, and community spaces. Explores the people who have always been here and their perspectives, Utah’s unique history of statehood, and the push-pull factors that have brought people to Utah over time. Highlights the state’s distinctive achievements, attractions, innovations, and what that makes Utah an amazing place to be. Illustrates Utah’s sense of community, character, and thriving culture,
